verdict.rationale: The evidence covers MoQ relay creation, token-scoped publish/subscribe auth, and low-latency QUIC streaming. Nothing documents routing a live session into a speech-to-text, model, and text-to-speech voice-agent pipeline. This is a fair question for a realtime media relay, so the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.
